verdict.rationale: The SDK documents human-in-the-loop tool-call approval that pauses runs and returns interruptions for resume, giving fine-grained control over individual tool invocations, plus guardrails for input and output validation and dedicated Sandbox agents and CodeInterpreterTool for isolated execution. Independent commentary corroborates sandbox execution as a real, actively-used feature with multiple provider backends, though it notes differing mental models across providers, suggesting the abstraction is not fully uniform. missing for 10: a first-class declarative tool-permission or allowlist system beyond per-call approval, and independent security audit or hands-on test proving sandbox isolation holds under adversarial conditions
